difficulty_reason: The proof must generalize endpoints before it can use identity induction, and control truncation levels of the code universe and inverse homotopies. This supplies H2 synthetic homotopy material.

compared.difference: This is the general path-space/truncation comparison. Circle path spaces have a different integer code, and the long exact sequence uses this identity as background without proving or separately counting it.
Hypercubical manifolds concerns a different cubical presentation, not this book claim.
A Whitehead result for test categories has different objects and hypotheses; not this finitely truncated type theorem.
